answer_2.quote: Results are reported in Table. HD-PiSSA achieves the best results across all models on the GSM8K, MATH, and HumanEval datasets. On the GSM8K test set for LLaMA-2-7B, HD-PiSSA surpasses PiSSA and LoRA by 3.79% and 8.34%, respectively.
